second_stage_trimming_review.authority_boundary: No option changes C1-C7, D101, universe breadth, feature/engine/language/surface coverage, historical semantics, performance requirements, or evidence-retention semantics without a new Program Owner decision.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: Historical versions outside the selected transition-directed probes would no longer have full-vector reference observations; unchanged behavior away from selected transitions would remain unmeasured.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Hold the conservative 3.00 platform multiplier and current-version full vectors; solve the maximum fraction of the historical full-vector increment that can remain under 10 GB. This is a capacity break-even, not proof that a scientifically valid transition set exists.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Smallest targeted break-even among the demonstrated fitting choices; it preferentially reduces historical coverage multiplication but requires a separately justified transition set.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: Conservative certification would no longer contain the full three-times platform/architecture matrix; non-canary coordinates would exist only after a trigger and could lack reference results.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Replace the established conservative 3.00 multiplier with the already established 1.25 lower/canary multiplier while retaining full historical vectors.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Largest storage relief, but it replaces a complete conservative platform/architecture reference matrix and therefore sacrifices broader reference capability than the targeted historical break-even.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: Fewer independent performance/conformance repetitions would reduce precision and rare-event detection; applying this envelope to non-benchmark obligations would also remove coverage and is not authorized.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Mathematical break-even if an equivalent fraction of all conservative executions were removable. The P20-T01A denominator does not separately expose benchmark-only repetitions, so this is an upper envelope requiring a future classified denominator before use.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Fits with near-minimal savings, but is ranked behind targeted historical reduction because the current denominator cannot isolate benchmark repetitions from core coverage.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: The 15% conservative diagnostic reserve would disappear; unexpected routine diagnostics could hit the hard cap or be unavailable unless a separate anomaly path succeeds.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Remove only the established 15% conservative diagnostic reserve; retain existing P19 diagnostics and the 1 GB fixed reserve.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Preserves existing facts but does not fit alone and removes the planned operational margin for unexpected diagnostics.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: Exact per-process wall-time measurements would not be reconstructible, eliminating raw latency distributions and weakening historical performance comparison. Historical-only savings would be smaller than this full-corpus upper bound.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Actual re-encoding after deleting every process wall_time_ms fact from the P19 semantic model; intentionally non-reconstructible and used only as an upper bound.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Removes core raw performance facts yet closes less than two percent of the capacity gap.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: Manifest-level closed-set reconciliation and root commitment would be lost; this is prohibited by the evidence contract and is shown only to demonstrate low marginal storage value.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Set the measured minimal-manifest class to zero while retaining other classes; shared index bytes remain.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: Prohibited integrity loss for negligible savings; it cannot resolve the capacity gap.

options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.exact_capability_lost: None: the strongest lossless representation already stores 26 canonical logical templates once and deterministically derives all 100,000 logical identities. Further deletion has no demonstrated lossless saving.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.measurement_basis: Already realized in the certified lossless archive.
options_ranked_by_storage_and_scientific.owner_review_rationale: No additional lossless reduction exists; retained only to document that this requested optimization has already been exhausted.

second_stage_trimming_review.reason: The strongest certified lossless expected case fits, but the conservative retained corpus exceeds the 10 GB hard cap.
